channel.title: Duckling Tablet blog
channel.description: Notes on the apps, the lockdown on each platform, and what a child does with a tablet that runs only learning apps.

item.title: How to set up an Android tablet with Duckling
item.description: The steps that lock an Android tablet to Duckling, as the parent area shows them. Pairing, the parent PIN, pinning, a screen lock, and the home screen, then what the child sees and how to undo it.

item.title: Duckling Tablet is on Google Play and the App Store
item.description: The Duckling Tablet app is published for Android tablets and iPads, with the Windows installer on this site. What the app does, what the parent portal controls, and what the first week looks like.
